prospective.note: Retried runs cannot rewrite an issued forecast; historical replay points are never inserted as issued records.

protocol.bootstrap: 1000 moving calendar-block samples, block=max(30,horizon); descriptive after historical research
protocol.features: closed ETH/BTC OHLCV only, plus verified flow lagged one extra calendar day; no macro/on-chain publication vintages
protocol.live_gate: new family issues as research until prospective evidence is sufficient; no historical result alone asserts predictive edge
protocol.objective: return MAE on prior matured out-of-sample origins; baseline reported separately

point_guard.basis: matured outer-training log returns, separately by horizon/window/month; preserve zero inside bounds
point_guard.reason: v1 development replay exposed extreme volatility-rescaling extrapolation in March 2020; v2 is a disclosed development revision, not a fresh holdout

protocol.probability: unconditional DOWN/FLAT/UP from past residuals, additive-one smoothing
protocol.purge: origin + horizon < fit cutoff - embargo, including inner early-stopping split
protocol.refit: calendar month start; daily saved-model inference
protocol.research_limit: Candidate design used previously explored history. Chronological replay is not an untouched prospective holdout.
protocol.retirement: legacy RF/KNN/HGB/Ridge candidates leave the active model roster; issued records and benchmarks remain auditable
protocol.safe_selection: also compare zero-return reference with the hybrid on prior OOF outcomes
protocol.selection: select CatBoost configuration, Transformer configuration, blend and amplitude using earlier matured OOF results only; equal short-model blend during warmup
protocol.source_limit: Reconstructed exchange history, not a claim of original publication-vintage verification.
protocol.target: direct horizon log return divided by (origin trailing 30-day volatility * sqrt(horizon))
protocol.uncertainty: empirical normalized OOF residuals from before the monthly cutoff; 10/90 quantiles, no guaranteed conformal coverage
